job.job_description:
Generative AI Engineer / AI Application Developer

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Generative AI Engineer with experience in building AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), modern AI frameworks, and cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have a strong software engineering background combined with hands-on expertise in Generative AI, prompt engineering, agentic AI frameworks, and enterprise-grade AI solution development.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies.
Build intelligent workflows and AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, and LangGraph.
Develop and optimize prompts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, and conversational AI applications.
Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise systems through REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
Design and implement vector search solutions using databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, FAISS, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search.
Develop and deploy AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, and other AI platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Ensure adherence to Responsible AI, model governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
Monitor, evaluate, and enhance AI model performance, accuracy, and reliability.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
3+ years of software development experience with at least 1+ year of hands-on experience in Generative AI technologies.
Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript, C#, or Java.
Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, RAG, and AI application development.
Experience with AI frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or LangGraph.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, Microservices Architecture, and cloud-native application development.
Experience with vector databases including Pinecone, Chroma, FAISS, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search.
Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, or equivalent Generative AI platforms.
Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, AI security, and model lifecycle management.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
